description: Append a 2D grid of values after the last row of a range's table in a spreadsheet. Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the count of cells updated by the append arrives via a follow-up message once it completes. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Append new rows to a Google Sheets spreadsheet as a background job: given the spreadsheet id, an A1-notation table range, and a grid of row values, Sheets finds the last populated row and inserts the new rows after it. Dispatch returns a job_id for tracking; completion delivers the count of cells written.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the spreadsheet append; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to append rows to a Google Sheets spreadsheet table.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id/range, values is empty or not a list of row lists, or missing session_id/flow_id context. gsuite.not_found: the spreadsheet id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a non-empty 2D values grid. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
